standing: DRAFT - NOT APPROVED. Drafted for Christian's review (his reply filed 29 October 2026, item 1: "Please draft the necessary engine-readable knowledge from our existing libraries for my review"). Nothing here is in the engine's knowledge: where this file is stored in the repository, it is a document only (docs/audits/drafts/ta02-composition/); the engine loads none of it, and nothing here may be presented as approved knowledge. Basis AUTHORED means the quoted words are his workbook's; the restatement into items is ours and unreviewed.

corrections.change: Notes section 5 no longer calls U2 a near-success: it reached the wording gate only after deleting PROP-134's origin clause and letting GF2's own end-line target stand for "a more advanced representative area". S5/O4 declaration notes and 11.b's fitNote now say the NON_CLAIMED reading is ours and that RPC-001's analog was NOT_AUTHORED. The NOT_AUTHORED alternative was measured (run U2n): it changes neither outcome nor game, so the uncorrected claim that it "would refuse until he places it" is withdrawn, and the placement is recorded as GF2's, not Attack Development's.

The scope note on every condition item (10.a-12.b) no longer gives engine evaluability as a reason and no longer says a possession makes an attack. It quotes RPC-ID-011, RPC-PROP-034/035, RPC-TR-002/004/013 and RPC-ID-026 and says WHOLE_GAME over-applies the condition; evaluability is recorded as engine limitation E8. Those rows are now cited as sources.
RPC-003-06 basis AUTHORED -> ASSUMED, fitNote begins OUR READING, GA-001 and RPC-REL-003 added as sources; the DV1 NON_CLAIMED declaration note says the item is an assumption.

RPC-003-12.c (V5 [type=control] "a more advanced representative area", AUTHORED) dropped. V5 [type=control] declared UNDECLARED, "Referent not stated; typing it is PR-2 (the C57 analog)". PR-2 now proposes adding an item.
PR-2 carries the question whether "while maintaining" is judged at the target or continuously, with his C57 words.
RPC-003-08: "Carried as the workbook says it" replaced by "OUR READING, as for RPC-001-15.a: START awards possession to one team."
RPC-003-09.b cites RPC-VAL-014 ("consequence, and representative information must remain intact where required"); basis stays ASSUMED.
RPC-003-08 kept and marked as addressing no element in any composition (ledger L-14).
T7 for START/SCORE/OUT_END_LINE/OUT_TOUCHLINE declared UNDECLARED with the open question tied to D1 (ledger L-13). Not declared NON_CLAIMED.

RPC-003-09.a's fitNote restores RPC-001-17.a's word, "the end of one episode is the start of the next (spec §5.7)" (contracts.json, RPC-001-17.a); the K1 draft had changed "episode" to "attack", which reintroduced the reading M2 removed. It now adds that a possession change is an episode boundary, not the start of an Attack Development attack.

PR-1 and PR-2 now quote his 16 October proviso on the RPC-001 analog in full (item 9 point 2, christian-2026-10-16.txt:111) beside the M8 words. PR-1 gains a question: typing the progression referent as GF2's target makes GF2's end line stand for "a more advanced representative area" (run U2n), so it is asked against the intended progression outcome, not because it composes.

The reply received 15 October 2026 and called his 16 October reply (christian-2026-10-16.txt:1) is cited by one label, "his 16 October reply", with file:line: 04.a (:117), the scope note on 10.a-12.b (:112), PR-1 and PR-2 (:111).

Basis AUTHORED -> ASSUMED by the M3 standard: the workbook says nothing about a START transition, and RPC-ID-011 / RPC-PROP-034 do not speak of a starting state as RPC-001-15.a's row does. Inert either way (it addresses no element, MEASURED).

V5 [type=control] and T7 [START, SCORE, OUT_END_LINE, OUT_TOUCHLINE] stay UNDECLARED; their notes now say why (the M4 prescription; the measurements were taken with it; NOT_AUTHORED would state the examined silence more exactly but would change only the verdict's subtype, derivation-rules-2026-09-18.md:159, unmeasured).

His RC1.1 Library (Attack Development section, held outside the repository) is folded in WITHOUT adding or changing any item, declaration or proposed ruling: no Library-only item is AUTHORED. Ledger L-10 now quotes the seven typical manipulations and five typical interaction regulations instead of calling the section unavailable; L-11 names the four never-staged affordance targets; L-06 names the fourth begin condition. libraryProposals points to the reconciliation (rpc-003-library-reconciliation.DRAFT.md), where each Library-only item is a proposal awaiting him. The standing line says where this file may be stored (a document only) instead of "Nothing here is in the repository".

about: The contribution contract for RPC-003 Attack Development, in the shape of the RPC-001 entry of docs/audits/conformance/stage-b/contracts.json (entry 0) as corpus-restatements.json leaves it, built from the RPC-003 workbook rows. `contractEntry` is that shape exactly, with two annotation keys on every item and on the entry, `standing` (DRAFT) and `source` (the workbook rows quoted, each with file and line). corpus.ts loadCorpusContracts passes unknown item keys through untouched (corpus.ts:93-96) and neither key is one the engine reads by name (types.ts ENGINE_ITEM_KEYS), so the two keys change nothing a derivation does; they are for review and for the draft store (E1). kind "restated" is chosen because knowledgeKey strips only "restated:" and "blind:" (derivation/knowledge-key.ts:13-17): any other prefix would never match the context id RPC-003. setIndex is omitted, as for the two blind entries, because this contract was not derived from a contributions file.

result.difficulties: Hardest part: RPC-PROP-134. It is one approved sentence with four parts (an origin, a progression, a control and a "rather than possession alone" exclusion), and none of the three conditions can be evaluated as written. The origin ("the attack's starting condition") is a state, not a place, and typing it needs an episode scope that does not exist for this context; its value line has no authored value. The progression referent is "a more advanced representative area": typing it as the target the scoring team attacks is the reading his C59 ruling approved for RPC-001, but the register admits it only from his ruling, so it stays open text here. The control clause ("while maintaining attacking possession") names no place, so its referent is left UNDECLARED, as RPC-001's was before C57.
